mapper.insert: INSERT INTO interview_report (session_id, score, content, status) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{score}, #{content}, 1)
INSERT INTO interview_report (session_id, status) VALUES (#{sessionId}, 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = IF(status = 2, 0, status), error_message = NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE interview_report SET score = #{score}, content = #{content}, status = 1, error_message = NULL WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}
